description: This file defines the Registry class in the Opencart system, which manages a collection of objects stored as key-value pairs. It provides methods for accessing, setting, checking, and unsetting registry entries.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: A class implementing a registry pattern for storing and retrieving objects by key in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve a value from the registry by key.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set a value in the registry by key.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if a key exists in the registry.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the object associated with the specified key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Associates an object with a key in the registry.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the registry.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated object from the registry.
